meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把 Telegram、Slack 等消息渠道接到对应的 agent 群组上,选择消息是并入同一会话还是各自独立,还能新增渠道组、改接渠道。它也会列出现有渠道和已授权用户的配置。
howto.when: 在你新增一个渠道之后、初次配置时,或想重新调整渠道与群组的对应关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看现在有哪些渠道已经接到 agent 群组了
say.note: 会列出已接、已配置未接和未配置的渠道

say.text: 把新加的 Slack 渠道接到现有的 agent 群组上
say.note: 会先问平台 ID 和隔离方式,再完成注册

say.text: 把这个渠道改接到另一个 agent 群组
say.note: 旧接线会删除,旧会话仍留在原群组

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude wires messaging channels such as Telegram or Slack to agent groups, picks whether messages share one session or stay separate, adds new channel groups, and lists current channel and role configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you add a channel, during initial setup, or whenever you want to reconfigure channels, groups, or isolation levels.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are currently wired to agent groups
say_en.note: Lists wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels

say_en.text: Wire the new Slack channel to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Asks for the platform ID and isolation choice, then registers

say_en.text: Move this channel to a different agent group
say_en.note: Deletes the old wiring and creates a new one
